composer-2.5-fast.concept: Catch stuttering beat shards that fall through SF fog; each shard snaps into a one-bar loop you're building live.
composer-2.5-fast.mechanic: rhythm tap to collect falling beat fragments
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: tap on the downbeat as shards cross the hit zone
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: hearing a complete pocket DJ loop assemble from scattered pieces in under a minute
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: BPM climbs, fog obscures lanes, and missed taps drop fragments into silence
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon wireframe pulses over gray summer fog banks

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Flick heat pulses across a home GPU heatsink before thermal throttling kills your local model run.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.mechanic: physics flick to vent rising temperature tiles
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: one chain reaction clears an entire overheating wave before the chip redlines
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: more cores spin up, ambient room temp climbs, cooldown windows shrink
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: macro copper PCB photography with orange thermal bloom

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw a single cable-car cable path down twin SF hills before the summer sunset window closes and fog swallows the bay.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.mechanic: draw a continuous path over gaps and rolling fog
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: drag to sketch the route, lift to commit
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: reaching the waterfront pier exactly as golden hour hits the waterline
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: fog patches bloom mid-path and the sunset timer accelerates
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: watercolor oranges bleeding into bay blues at magic hour

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Swipe drifting job-application bubbles into accept, reject, or shred bins before the inbox overflows — decoy trivia bubbles must be shredded, not filed.
gemini-3.1-pro.mechanic: sort and swipe bubbles into three lanes
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: swipe left, right, or up to route each bubble
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: clearing a full wave of applications without mis-filing a single decoy
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: bubble spawn rate doubles and decoys mimic real credentials
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: paper cutout HR desk with manila folders and rubber-stamp red ink
